article.headline: Stephen F. Austin opens season with a 120-61 win over Lyon
article.description: — Narit Chotikavanic had 18 points as Stephen F. Austin opened its season Monday with a 120-61 victory over Lyon.
article.linkText: Stephen F. Austin opens season with a 120-61 win over Lyon

categories.description: Lyon Scots @ Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks

event.description: Lyon Scots @ Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks

keywords: Lyon Scots @ Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks
article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Texas -- — Narit Chotikavanic had 18 points as Stephen F. Austin opened its season Monday with a 120-61 victory over Lyon. Chotikavanic went 6 for 9 from 3-point range for the Lumberjacks. M.J. Russell scored 17 points and added five rebounds. Marcus Scurry shot 5 for 11 from the field, including 4 for 10 from 3-point range, and 2 for 3 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points. Kyanu Simeone led the way for the Scots with 13 points. Tristian Thomas added 10 points for Lyon. Kaloyan Hristov also had eight points. Up next SFA hosts Texas Lutheran on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
